summary: This note is a short biographical entry on linguist Robert D. Borsley, covering his education and academic career. It traces his studies at the University College of North Wales and the University of Edinburgh, several research and teaching posts, his appointment at Bangor, and his 2000 move to the University of Essex.
one_line: Biographical note on Robert D. Borsley, a linguist whose academic career spanned Wales, Poland, London, Winchester, Dublin and Essex.
key_facts: Robert D. Borsley studied at the University College of North Wales, which is now the University of Wales, Bangor.
Robert D. Borsley studied at the University of Edinburgh, where he did his Ph.D.
Robert D. Borsley worked at the Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań.
Robert D. Borsley worked at University College London.
Robert D. Borsley worked at the IBM UK Scientific Centre in Winchester.
Robert D. Borsley worked at University College Dublin.
Robert D. Borsley became a lecturer in linguistics at the University of Wales, Bangor in 1986.
Robert D. Borsley was awarded a Personal Chair in 1997.
In 2000, Robert D. Borsley moved to the University of Essex.
